newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end lower in light volume.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end lower in light volume.

text.p: March 3 - U.S. debt futures ended lower. Volume was light on the close, as June T-bonds edged above 110-00. Traders said short-covering kept the market near the upper end of the day's range. One large U.S. firm, which was a good-sized seller earlier in the day, turned into a late buyer, a trader said. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuter.com))
